_about: Answer every case. allowed is true or false. label is one of the labels listed, or "none" for no label.
setup: The labels from least to most restrictive: Public, General, Confidential, Highly Confidential.

Lena, a Member of the Sales workspace, changes the Sales lakehouse's label from General to Confidential and leaves the box to apply it to downstream items selected. Fully automated downstream inheritance isn't turned on.
Every item in the cases is in the Sales workspace, and the lakehouse has fewer than 80 downstream items. No default label policy is set.

promote_lakehouse.question: Priya is a Contributor in the Sales workspace, so she has write permission on the Sales lakehouse. Can she mark it Promoted?

certify_as_workspace_admin.question: Tom is the Sales workspace's Admin. Certification is enabled for the organization, and Tom isn't one of the users the Fabric administrator specified to certify. Can he certify the Sales lakehouse?

master_data_on_pipeline.question: Ana is one of the users the Fabric administrator specified for Master data. Can she mark the nightly load pipeline as Master data?

promote_dashboard.question: Priya also has write permission on a Power BI dashboard in the workspace. Can she promote the dashboard?

apply_unpublished_label.question: Sam is in the list of users who can apply sensitivity labels in Fabric, but the Highly Confidential label isn't published to him in any label policy. Can he apply Highly Confidential to a warehouse?

sql_endpoint.question: After Lena's change, which label does the lakehouse's autogenerated SQL analytics endpoint have?
sql_endpoint.label: Confidential

notebook_created_from_lakehouse.question: After Lena's change, Priya creates a new notebook from the lakehouse and doesn't choose a label. Which label does the notebook have?
notebook_created_from_lakehouse.label: Confidential

model_unlabelled.question: The Sales semantic model is built on the lakehouse and had no label. Which label does it have after Lena's change?
model_unlabelled.label: Confidential

model_manual_general.question: The Region semantic model is built on the lakehouse; someone applied General to it by hand last month. Which label does it have after Lena's change?
model_manual_general.label: General

model_highly_confidential.question: The Payroll semantic model is built on the lakehouse and is already labelled Highly Confidential. Which label does it have after Lena's change?
model_highly_confidential.label: Highly Confidential

report_pdf_export.question: A report labelled Confidential is exported to PDF. Which label does the PDF carry?
report_pdf_export.label: Confidential

csv_export.question: The same report's data is exported to a .csv file. Which label does the .csv file carry?
csv_export.label: none
